seo.title: 9 Salisbury Avenue | Interior Design — Crio Creatives
seo.description: A residential interior design preview for 9 Salisbury Avenue, Kingston, by Crio Creatives.

hero.alt: A bright contemporary living room with soft neutral seating, slatted wood details, white brick media wall and wide balcony glazing
hero.description: An interior design study for 9 Salisbury Avenue, Kingston — composed around natural light, refined materials and everyday function.

sections.label: PROJECT OVERVIEW
sections.title: Quiet confidence.  Considered detail.
paragraphs: At 9 Salisbury Avenue, Kingston, a residential interior shaped by natural light, layered neutrals and the warmth of timber. From the open-plan living area to private bedrooms and functional spaces, the design language remains purposeful and understated.

sections.label: 01 / LIVING
sections.title: An atmosphere  of ease.
paragraphs: Open views, tactile materials and a restrained palette establish a relaxed setting for everyday living.

sections.note: DESIGN NOTE / 01  Timber accents and white brick introduce warmth and texture, while subtle lighting lets the space transition from daylight to evening.

sections.label: 02 / BEDROOM
sections.title: Private spaces.  Personal character.
paragraphs: A cooler accent palette complements the same warm joinery and soft finishes seen throughout the residence.
